summary: ECHOES OF MARS is a browser-based, first-person 3D survival mystery game that introduces children to the challenges of living on Mars through interactive gameplay. Players explore a mysterious Martian outpost and complete five missions involving oxygen and life support, solar storms, greenhouse cultivation, electrical power, and communication systems. Through puzzles, timed challenges, memory sequences, system repairs, and exploration, players learn essential space survival concepts by solving problems themselves. By transforming scientific and engineering concepts into an engaging gaming experience, the project addresses NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, Challenge 3, while inspiring younger audiences to develop curiosity about space exploration, problem-solving, and the technologies needed for future human missions to Mars.
details:
ECHOES OF MARS is a browser-based, first-person 3D survival mystery game developed using HTML5, CSS, JavaScript and Three.js.

Players explore a Martian outpost and complete five missions focusing on oxygen and life support, solar storms, greenhouse cultivation, electrical power management, and communication systems. Each mission features different interactive challenges, including puzzles, memory games, timed tasks, system repairs and navigation obstacles.

The game also incorporates NASA's DONKI API to retrieve real solar flare and coronal mass ejection (CME) records, connecting gameplay to actual space-weather observations. By combining 3D exploration, storytelling and mini-games, the project makes complex space-related concepts more accessible and enjoyable for children aged 7–12.

Its main benefits are encouraging curiosity, developing problem-solving skills and introducing the importance of scientific knowledge and resource management in space exploration. Our intended impact is to inspire younger generations to become more interested in space science and understand the challenges of establishing human life beyond Earth.

During development, our team considered the target audience's age, gameplay simplicity, accessibility, engagement, educational value and scientific relevance. We aimed to create an experience that balances learning and entertainment, allowing children to discover the challenges of surviving on Mars through exploration and hands-on problem-solving rather than reading explanations alone. ChatGPT was also used as a supporting tool for coding assistance, debugging and documentation.
